scope: Independent read-only review of the Snyk review evaluator and its tests. CI activation and remote scan integrity are not approved or performed here.
reviewedControls: Exact finding identity, rule and primary path
Complete sorted fingerprint commitment and source-location/dataflow evidence digest
Every SARIF flow source and independent context source bound to exact SHA256 bytes
Only false-positive disposition can pass; open/accepted-risk/proposed remain blocking
Malformed or empty thread flows and invalid scanner execution metadata rejected
CLI status restricted to0or1; filesystem realpath must remain in checkout

independentAdversarialCases.name: error-notification
independentAdversarialCases.reason: SARIF reports an execution or configuration error.

independentAdversarialCases.name: string-execution-success
independentAdversarialCases.reason: SARIF reports incomplete or invalid execution.

independentAdversarialCases.name: findings-exit-without-results
independentAdversarialCases.reason: SARIF findings exit has no finding evidence.

limits: Review manifest provenance remains trusted repository content, not a scanner attestation. The original SARIF hash is audit provenance; current result fingerprints/flow and source/context commitments enforce applicability. Live deployment/TLS and provider acceptance remain outside this review.
